EmailTemplate.name: ITA Mass Password Update
EmailTemplate.subject: ITA Mass Password Update
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
I was able to reset everyone's password to "changeme". With this mass update, it will also reset your password. Unfortunately, there isn't a way that we can send a mass email to all of your employees regarding their temporary password through Time and Attendance. I've attached a document that includes all the usernames of your employees; you may distribute this if needed.
After they log in successfully using the temporary password through your specific Time and Attendance site: https://timestar.insperity.com/XXX, they will be prompted to select a new, private password. Once that is complete, your employees will be able to log in using the same site and username, with the newly selected private password.
I've also attached a document here which details how you, as a system administrator, can reset employees’ passwords as needed in the future. You can also access these instructions on our Help Center's FAQ page here. If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
8401 Greenway Blvd. Suite 1100 | Middleton, WI 53562 OFFICE: 800-314-8223 | FAX: 262-364-3800
